saveTime.description: Stop interrupting services to answer the phone. MaiAI handles booking inquiries, reschedules, and basic questions 24/7, giving your staff more time to focus on delivering amazing nail art.

increaseRevenue.title: Increase Revenue Per Guest
increaseRevenue.description: Maximize your profit margins without being pushy. MaiAI politely suggests relevant add-ons during the booking process based on the service selected.

personalizedExperience.title: Deliver Personalized Guest Experiences
personalizedExperience.description: Make every client feel like a VIP. MaiAI remembers their favorite nail tech, preferred polish colors, and even allergies, prompting your staff before the client walks in.

preference.title: Preference Profiles

stylistMatching.title: Stylist Matching
stylistMatching.description: Smartly routes clients to the ideal technician based on requested services (e.g., intricate 3D art vs. classic gel) and historical preferences.

nudges.title: Automated Nudges & Upsells
nudges.description: Sends gentle, customized reminders and suggests perfectly timed add-ons (like a spa pedicure upgrade) in a conversational, non-pushy tone.

dashboard.title: Executive Dashboard
dashboard.description: Translates daily interactions into actionable insights, helping you understand client trends, staff utilization, and emerging service demands at a glance.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.description: Get up and running in minutes, not days.

0.title: Create Your Salon Profile
0.description: Set up a custom profile for your salon and define services, stylist skills, and booking rules. MaiAI creates a dedicated CRM per salon that stores guest preferences and history, and syncs with your calendar and staff availability for seamless scheduling.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about getting started with MaiAI.

0.question: Does MaiAI replace my current booking system?
0.answer: It can, but it doesn't have to! MaiAI can act as your complete all-in-one CRM and booking system, or it can integrate as a smart layer on top of popular systems like Square, Mindbody, or Phorest.

1.question: How hard is it to train the AI on my salon's rules?
1.answer: Not hard at all. Our onboarding process involves a simple interview where we ask about your services, timing, staff skills, and preferences. MaiAI learns from this and handles complex scenarios—like requiring extra time for removal before a new set—automatically.

2.question: Can clients still call to book?
2.answer: Absolutely! MaiAI answers phone calls naturally and books appointments just like a human receptionist would. Clients can also text or use your website—whatever they prefer.

3.question: Is client data secure?
3.answer: Yes. We use enterprise-grade encryption, comply with all data protection regulations, and never share your client information with third parties. Your data stays yours.
